profile.description: Operational AMX product lane. Host topology is supplied by the campaign; this contract requires the resolved Design-D decoder leaf.

quality_gate.audio_gate: existing per-ISA audio/WER/SIM/ear gate on the fixed bank

parity.notes: Product lane, not a common-control comparison. Design-D/fused are shape-gated at individual decoder calls; the dispatch preflight verifies the capability/policy leaf before traffic.

hardware.cpu_family: host-specific Xeon AMX; measured topology must be supplied by the campaign
hardware.notes: Topology is intentionally not baked into an ISA lane. Requalify worker/thread split per host.

precision.gemm_backend: AMX INT8/BF16 where the resolved shape gate selects it

QWEN_BLAS_OWN.why: engine owns the decoder/BLAS compute budget

OPENBLAS_THREAD_TIMEOUT.why: keep the external BLAS pool from spinning against the engine pool

OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.why: must be absent so engine-owned BLAS sizing is effective

OMP_NUM_THREADS.why: must be absent; the engine profile owns the CPU budget

QWEN_CP_PREC.why: pin CP precision rather than inheriting --int8/default policy

QWEN_CP_PREFILL2.why: pin the current x86 prefill2 policy

QWEN_DECODER_BATCH.why: request the real AMX ragged decoder path

QWEN_KAI_LHS.why: Arm-only; must be absent on the x86 AMX lane

QWEN_KAI_QKV_FUSED.why: Arm-only; must be absent on the x86 AMX lane

QWEN_KAI_NCHUNK.why: Arm-only; must be absent on the x86 AMX lane

QWEN_NO_AMX.why: do not let an inherited AMX kill switch invalidate the product lane

QWEN_NO_KLEIDI.why: not an Arm lane; make the unsupported backend explicit

QWEN_NO_VNNI.why: retain VNNI fallback for shapes below the AMX gate

QWEN_NO_VNNI_QKV.why: do not disable the x86 VNNI QKV fallback

QWEN_NO_X86_QKV.why: do not disable the x86 QKV path

QWEN_NO_VNNI_ROWSUM.why: retain cached VNNI GEMV row sums

QWEN_NO_BF16DOT.why: retain the AVX-512 BF16 matvec fallback where selected

QWEN_VNNI_PREPACK.why: rejected experimental VNNI prepack; must not be inherited

QWEN_AMX_MIN_B.why: pin shared AMX gate for BF16/Q4

QWEN_AMX_INT8_MIN_B.why: pin the qualified AMX INT8 crossover

QWEN_AMX_INT8_QKV_MIN_B.why: pin the AMX INT8 QKV crossover

QWEN_AMX_INT8_MIN_ROWS_PER_THREAD.why: pin the measured AMX INT8 work-per-thread gate

QWEN_AMX_NCHUNK.why: experimental x86 row chunking; must remain absent

QWEN_VNNI_NCHUNK.why: experimental VNNI row chunking; must remain absent

QWEN_X86_NCHUNK.why: experimental generic x86 row chunking; must remain absent

QWEN_POOL_SPIN.why: frozen AMX reference value; not portable without requalification

QWEN_PREFILL_MATMAT.why: require the native AMX BF16 prefill leaf

QWEN_Q4_NAIVE.why: do not silently select the scalar Q4 path

QWEN_SD_AMX.why: legacy decoder switch; Design-D is controlled by QWEN_SD_AMX_D

QWEN_SD_AMX_BF16.why: INT8 is the product decoder precision

QWEN_SD_AMX_D.why: require persistent AMX Design-D decoder representation

QWEN_SD_DIRECT_CONVT.why: default-off experimental path; not part of the frozen reference

QWEN_SD_DIRECT_DWCONV.why: default-off experimental path; not part of the frozen reference

QWEN_SD_DIRECT_INPUT.why: default-off experimental path; not part of the frozen reference

QWEN_SD_INT8_BLK.why: pin the x86 decoder quantization block

QWEN_SD_POOL.why: decoder work uses the engine-owned pool

QWEN_SD_WINDOWED.why: explicitly disable the legacy windowed fallback so the exact streaming/ragged decoder path is resolved

QWEN_SERVER_ASYNC_OUTPUT.why: synchronous output is the reference contract

QWEN_SERVER_NO_DECODER_BATCH.why: presence flag must remain absent when decoder batching is requested

QWEN_TTS_STREAM_LAYOUT.why: SL-1 remains default-off in the frozen reference

qualification.workload: Operational lane contract; no new hardware result is claimed by this file.
qualification.notes: Run the declared quality gate and preflight before accepting performance data.
